title: ChargeFW molecule input JSON 1.0
description: A collection of molecules with optional connectivity and coordinate conformers. Array order defines molecule, atom, bond, conformer, and coordinate order.

schema_version.description: Version of the ChargeFW molecule input format.

molecules.description: Molecules in input order. Their array indices are the record indices used in results.

id.description: Optional caller-facing record identifier, retained as the result record ID.

atoms.description: Atoms in calculation order. Every bond endpoint and coordinate row refers to this array by zero-based index.

bonds.description: Optional molecular connectivity. Endpoint indices are zero-based references into atoms; each bond connects two distinct atoms.

conformers.description: Optional conformers in source order. Each conformer supplies one coordinate row for every atom. The reader can retain the first conformer or all conformers.

atomic_number.description: Element atomic number supported by ChargeFW.

formal_charge.description: Formal charge assigned to this atom.

atoms.description: The two distinct zero-based atom indices connected by the bond. Each index must be less than the molecule's atom count.

order.description: Bond order: 1 for single, 2 for double, or 3 for triple.

id.description: Optional conformer identifier, retained as the conformer name.

coordinates.description: Cartesian coordinates in Angstroms, in atom order. Supply exactly one row per molecule atom.

coordinate.description: One atom's finite x, y, and z coordinates in Angstroms.
